summary: Frontend visual verification of /posdns.html at desktop (1440x800) and mobile (412x900). Blue-white modern theme is correctly restored (no vintage cream/serif/brown/rust elements). Form structure (#username, #password, #submitBtn 'Masuk') is intact. HOWEVER, the reported logo-overflow bug is NOT fixed: the still overflows its 64x64 (desktop) and 48x48 (mobile) container and overlaps neighboring text.

ui_bugs.issue: Logo renders at 64x109.7px inside a 64x64 container and OVERLAPS the h1 'Daneswara POS' (img.bottom=652.3 > h1.top=638.6). object-fit:contain is set on img but has no effect because the img's element box itself is oversized.
Logo renders at 48x82.3px inside a 48x48 .mark container, extending down over the 'MASUK' eyebrow area. Visible in mobile screenshot.

action_items: Fix logo overflow: root cause is '.logo { display: grid; place-items: center }' — place-items:center prevents .mark from stretching, so .mark sizes to img content and img height:100% becomes indeterminate; browser falls back to intrinsic aspect (746x1279 => ratio 1.71) producing a 64x110 img box.

Suggested fixes (choose one): (a) Add 'align-self: stretch; justify-self: stretch;' to .mark rules; (b) Change .hero .logo and .box .brand .mark parents to 'display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden;'; (c) Set explicit fixed dimensions on .mark (64x64 desktop, 48x48 mobile) with overflow:hidden; (d) Use 'max-width:100%; max-height:100%; width:auto; height:auto;' on the img together with object-fit:contain and fixed .mark size.
critical_code_review_comments: The CSS pattern of nesting width:100%/height:100% img inside a grid parent using place-items:center creates a circular sizing scenario. Either the parent must have an intrinsic size and force the child to stretch, or the child should use max-width/max-height instead of width/height 100%.

success_rate.frontend: 50% (theme OK, logo overflow bug still present at both viewports)

test_credentials: Not used (login submission intentionally not attempted per request)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest /posdns.html at 1440x800 and 412x900. Verify: (1) '.hero .logo .mark img' getBoundingClientRect height <= 64 and does not overlap '.hero h1'; (2) '.box .brand .mark img' getBoundingClientRect height <= 48 and does not overlap '.eyebrow'; (3) Theme remains blue-white (button rgb(37,99,235), hero::after rgba(23,37,84,.72), no serif/vintage).
rca_of_the_issue: The .logo container uses display:grid + place-items:center. This aligns (but does not stretch) the .mark child, so .mark sizes to its content. The img sets width:100%; height:100% relative to .mark, which itself is sized by the img — indeterminate. The browser resolves width to 64px (via the .logo grid cell's inline-size propagation) but height falls back to the natural aspect ratio of the PNG (746x1279), yielding ~110px tall. object-fit:contain is a no-op because the element box, not the image content, is oversized.
